tool_description: PanDermDDX provides differential diagnoses of 23 common skin conditions for a clinical skin image. By default it outputs a single best diagnosis. Use --top3ddx or --top5ddx to return the top-3 or top-5 ranked diseases with confidence scores.
demo_commands:
docker run --rm --gpus all \
  -v /home/pathto/Dermnet:/data \
  pandermddx \
  python infer.py --image_path /data/imagesTs/sample.jpg --output single_result.txt

docker run --rm --gpus all \
  -v /home/pathto/Dermnet:/data \
  pandermddx \
  python infer.py --image_path /data/imagesTs/sample.jpg --output top3_result.txt --top3ddx

docker run --rm --gpus all \
  -v /home/pathto/Dermnet:/data \
  pandermddx \
  python infer.py --image_path /data/imagesTs/sample.jpg --output top5_result.txt --top5ddx

image_path.description: Absolute path to a clinical skin image (PNG/JPG).

output.description: Destination path for the TXT result file.

top3ddx.description: If true, returns the top-3 ranked diagnoses.

top5ddx.description: If true, returns the top-5 ranked diagnoses.

results_txt.description: Path to the TXT file containing predicted diseases and probabilities.

txt_format.description:
• Single diagnosis: one line '<disease>: <probability>'
• Top-N: N lines '<rank>. <disease>: <probability>'
